name: Colonel Cluckingham's Poultry Compound
tagline: THE RANK IS VACANT. THE FRYERS ARE NOT.
address: 44190 Frontage Access Road, Bay 6, Behind the Retention Pond, Grimsley Township
about: Colonel Cluckingham's Poultry Compound is a pressure-frying facility operating under a hospitality license. The title of Colonel is a rank conferred internally and is presently vacant; the recipe survives the officer. All poultry is processed on site under pressure that is monitored but not published.
announcement: NOTICE: The Compound's gravy line is now connected to the township's secondary main. Residents may experience taste in their tap water. This is expected.

reviews.name: Denton R.
reviews.text: Ordered the Municipal Bucket for four people. Fed eleven and a dog. The dog has not been the same, which I take as a compliment.

reviews.name: Marguerite O.
reviews.text: I declined the bun and was charged for declining the bun. The charge was explained to me clearly and I accepted it.

reviews.name: Vance T.
reviews.text: The Load-Bearing Biscuit held up a bookshelf for six days. Ate it on the seventh. Ten out of ten.

reviews.name: Priscilla H.
reviews.text: Selected the Standpipe Hookup without a compatible residence. That was on me. The lawn is fine now.

reviews.name: Odell B.
reviews.text: Tier Nine is unrated for a reason and I would like the Compound to know I understand that reason now.

menu.name: The Bucket Program
menu.blurb: Buckets are sized by the population they are expected to pacify.

items.name: The Municipal Bucket
items.desc: Pressure-fried poultry in the quantity a small municipality is understood to require. The bucket is filled above the rim as a matter of policy.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a plain paper bucket of pressure-fried chicken shot from directly overhead, straight down into the vessel. Craggy mahogany crust, torn breading shards, a thigh wedged upright against the rim, the pile heaped several inches above the lip and slumping over one side, steam curling off the crevices, oil pooling in every fissure. Behind it a stainless fryer station with red-and-white vertical stripes softly out of focus, a dented aluminum sheet tray in the foreground. Warm Southern-gothic tungsten light rakes in from the left, visible fryer haze in the air, oil sheen, rich shadow. 50mm, shallow depth of field, high micro-contrast. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

items.name: The Pressure Doctrine Sandwich
items.desc: A whole pressure-cycled breast on a bun rated for approximately sixty percent of it. The overhang is intentional and is not a defect.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: an enormous pressure-fried chicken sandwich sitting in a white styrofoam clamshell with the lid folded back, the craggy breaded fillet overhanging the small bun on every side, pickle slices sliding out one edge, a smear of hot honey on the styrofoam, a few crust shards fallen beside it. Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out hotspot on the top bun, hard black shadow thrown behind the clamshell. Framed slightly crooked with the clamshell cut off at the right edge, sitting on a scratched stainless prep counter beside a squeeze bottle. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, visible sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.
